function.name: READ_FILE
function.description: Read file with line numbers

function.name: WRITE_FILE
function.description: Write content to file

function.name: EDIT
function.description: Replace string in file

function.name: GLOB
function.description: Find files by pattern

function.name: GREP
function.description: Search files for pattern

function.name: EXECUTE_BASH
function.description: Run a shell command that is expected to finish. For long-running services such as Django runserver, use START_BACKGROUND_COMMAND instead.

working_dir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to ./runtime_output under the Agent project directory.

function.name: START_BACKGROUND_COMMAND
function.description: Start a long-running shell command in the background and return a service_id for later checks, output reads, and stop.

working_dir.description: Working directory for this background command. Defaults to ./runtime_output under the Agent project directory.

service_id.description: Optional stable id. If omitted, the tool generates one.

startup_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning initial status/output.

function.name: CHECK_BACKGROUND_COMMAND
function.description: Check whether a background command is still running and return its status.

function.name: READ_BACKGROUND_COMMAND_OUTPUT
function.description: Read recent output captured from a background command.

tail_chars.description: Maximum number of trailing output characters to return.

function.name: STOP_BACKGROUND_COMMAND
function.description: Stop a background command by service_id and return final status/output.

function.name: MAKE_PLAN
function.description: Break down complex task into simple, executable steps and execute sequentially.

function.name: LOAD_SKILL_DETAIL_BY_NAME
function.description: Load content of SKILL.md by skill name.

function.name: GET_TIME
function.description: Get current time in format of (%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S)

function.name: WEB_SEARCH
function.description: Lowest-priority fallback web search tool. When network search is needed, prefer other network search tools first. Use this only when no other network search tool is available, or when other network search tools fail, return errors, or cannot provide useful results. Searches the web and summarizes the results using the model.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to retrieve.

function.name: LIST_DIR
function.description: List directory contents in order for a specific path, current directory as default(ignores node_modules, .git, etc.).

function.name: SUB_AGENT
function.description: Delegate a task to a specialized sub-agent with its own role and independent context. When a complex task can be broken down into multiple independent, unrelated subtasks, call this function for each subtask.

role.description: The sub-agent's specialty, e.g. 'Python backend developer'

function.name: LOAD_FULL_MEMORY_CONTEXT
function.description: Load the full long-term memory context for a completed task by task_id. Use this after identifying a relevant task_id from the memory view or task index.

task_id.description: The task id, for example task_20260507_103012_a8f3c2.

function.name: MEDIA_PROBE
function.description: Inspect a local audio, image, or video file before deciding how to process it. Use this to get file type, size, dimensions, duration, and stream metadata.

function.name: GET_VISION_MODELS
function.description: List local vision models available for image understanding. Call this before IMAGE_DESCRIBE when you need to choose a model.

function.name: IMAGE_DESCRIBE
function.description: Describe or answer questions about a local image. Use this when the task requires visual understanding beyond plain text extraction.

prompt.description: Optional instruction for what to inspect in the image.

model.description: Optional vision model name from GET_VISION_MODELS. If omitted, the default vision model is used.

function.name: IMAGE_DOWNLOAD
function.description: Download an image from a URL to a local file. Use this when an image is provided as a web address and later image tools need a local path.

output_path.description: Optional output path. Relative paths are written under runtime_output/media.

function.name: IMAGE_OCR
function.description: Extract readable text from a local image. Use this for screenshots, scanned documents, receipts, or images where text is the main target.

languages.description: OCR language codes, such as eng+chi_sim.

function.name: IMAGE_TRANSFORM
function.description: Create a modified copy of a local image by cropping, resizing, rotating, changing format, or reducing size. Use this when a later step needs an adjusted image file.

output_path.description: Optional output path. Relative paths are written under runtime_output/media.

format.description: Output format such as png, jpg, webp.

function.name: AUDIO_TRANSCRIBE
function.description: Transcribe speech from a local audio file. Choose txt for plain text, json for timestamped segments, or srt for subtitles; txt is the default.

model.description: Optional transcription model name or local model path.

language.description: Optional language code such as en or zh.

function.name: AUDIO_CONVERT
function.description: Create a converted or trimmed copy of a local audio file. Use this to change format, duration, sample rate, or channel count.

format.description: Output format such as wav, mp3, flac, m4a.

function.name: VIDEO_DOWNLOAD
function.description: Download a video from a URL to a local file, preferring MP4 when available. Use this when a task provides a video link and later video tools need a local path. Some sites require cookies; if a previous call asks for cookies, ask the user to export a valid cookies file and pass its local path as cookie_path.

output_path.description: Optional output path. Relative paths are written under runtime_output/media.

cookie_path.description: Optional local cookies file path for sites that require login or cookies. Use this only when the user has provided a cookies file path or a previous VIDEO_DOWNLOAD result asked for cookies.

function.name: VIDEO_EXTRACT_FRAMES
function.description: Extract image frames from a local video. Use timestamps for specific moments or interval_seconds for regular sampling.

function.name: VIDEO_TRANSCRIBE
function.description: Transcribe speech from a local video. Choose txt for plain text, json for timestamped segments, or srt for subtitles; txt is the default.

model.description: Optional transcription model name or local model path.

function.name: VIDEO_CONVERT
function.description: Create a converted, trimmed, compressed, resized, or audio-only copy of a local video. Use this when a task needs a new media file for later processing or delivery.

format.description: Output video format such as mp4, webm, mkv, or audio format when extract_audio is true.
